subtitles.en: On this edition of Next Africa, Formula One to return to the continent for the first time in more than three decades, Rwanda wins the right to host

subtitles.en: the first race on African soil since 1993.
subtitles.zh: 这是自1993年以来在非洲土地上的首场比赛。

subtitles.en: There will be a new track, a new airport and new hotels.

subtitles.en: Weeks floor weather hosting F1 will deliver the economic gains Rwanda is hoping for.

subtitles.en: in the country a lot of work. Welcome to Next Africa.
subtitles.zh: 需要大量工作。欢迎来到《下一站非洲》。

subtitles.en: I'm Jennifer Zabasagia in Johannesburg. More than 30 years after the last Formula One Grand Prix in Africa, the competition is returning to the continent.
subtitles.zh: 我是詹妮弗·扎巴萨吉亚，在约翰内斯堡报道。非洲上一场F1大奖赛三十多年后，赛事重返非洲大陆。

subtitles.en: Rwanda has been chosen to host beating competition from countries including South Africa and Morocco.
subtitles.zh: 卢旺达击败南非和摩洛哥等国，被选为主办地。

subtitles.en: For many years, we have spoken about our desire to return, but always said we would return in the right way, with the right vision and the right partners.
subtitles.zh: 多年来，我们一直谈论重返的愿望，但始终表示将以正确方式、正确愿景和正确伙伴回归。

clip_research.source_claim: 卢旺达赢得F1非洲站主办权，将新建赛道、机场和酒店，这是非洲自1993年以来首次举办F1比赛。
clip_research.public_baseline: 公开报道称卢旺达与F1签署十年协议，非洲大奖赛将从2030年代初起举办，比赛地点在布格塞拉/基加利附近，新赛道尚待建成。
clip_research.surprise_gap: 节目以“已赢得主办权”的既成事实口吻讲述，而公开报道显示赛事最早2030年代初举行、赛道尚未建成，时间与落地程度存在落差。

evidence.fact: 卢旺达击败南非、摩洛哥等竞争对手获选主办；将新建赛道、机场和酒店；为1993年以来非洲首场F1。
